description: A painted scene in dark, warm tones. A man in a waistcoat and rolled white sleeves leans in to fit small metal electrodes to the scalp of a young man seated in a wooden chair in a dim workshop. Trailing black wires run from the electrodes to a brass-and-black drum recording instrument on the right, which feeds out a long paper strip covered in wavy, handwriting-like marks. Glass jars sit on shelves behind. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge with no frame.
